initialAppearanceIssue: Without an explicit binding for whitespace collapsed at an old line break, widening the text left an unintended gap at the old join.
firstJoinAttempt: A strip from the stroke endpoint was faint because it included the fading pen cap.
currentJoinRule: Retain the actual space CFI; borrow a one-point strip from the middle of the preceding character column when it must become visible. Suppress it when the target space is collapsed.
meaning: This synthesizes a join from native ink. The final native composites show the candidate; pressure, texture and seam acceptance remain human questions.
